commands.text: Beyond the crossing, a stretch of firm ground has become a place to stop. It needs to become a place other people can use.

commands.speaker: nara_vell
commands.text: Keep the exit wide. Resting people should not become a wall for arriving people.

commands.speaker: marek_vane
commands.text: The volunteers have brought water and cloth. They need to know where each belongs.

commands.speaker: or_volunteer
commands.text: We can keep it going if someone shows us the order.

commands.speaker: nara_vell
commands.text: Then we will show you. After that, you will show us.

commands.speaker: marek_vane
commands.text: She accepts demonstrations more readily than thanks.
